n: Coding Ireland unplugged make your own board game
t: A 45 minute beginner lesson where pupils design a board game and manual.
steps: Find the Make your own Board Game lesson in the Unplugged Adventures course on the Coding Ireland site.
Check whether the course needs a subscription.
Open the lesson and read the plan.
Set up a projector or interactive whiteboard.
Gather paper, markers, and board game pieces.
Ask pupils to recall board games they have played.
Give pupils time to build the board and write the manual.
